maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is service fees on new travel bookings of vacation rentals, experiences and services, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers and travelers booking stays, experiences and services; hosts' fees come from private guests.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through its booking marketplace for stays, experiences and services; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Travelers can easily book on Vrbo, Booking.com or hotels; hosts can multi-list, so switching costs are low.
